notablePrerequisites: Marath has at least two +1/+1 counters on it.
description:
Activate Marath by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, giving itself two +1/+1 counters.
Activate Marath by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, giving Cryptic Trilobite two +1/+1 counters.
Activate Cryptic Trilobite's first ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {C}{C} that can only be spent to activate abilities.
Repeat for infinite +1/+1 counters on Cryptic Trilobite.
Activate Cryptic Trilobite's first ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {C}{C} that can only be spent to activate abilities.
Activate Marath's ability by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, giving itself two +1/+1 counters.
Repeat from step 5 to get infinite {C} that can only be spent to activate abilities and to put infinite +1/+1 counters on Marath, with which you can use to activate Marath's ability infinite times.
